headline: Copper Market Registers Deficit of 30,000 Metric Tons in September: ICSG
summary: The International Copper Study Group reported a 30,000 metric ton deficit in the copper market for September. The market had a surplus over the first nine months of the year.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in construction, electrical grids and electric vehicles, so supply-demand balance shapes its price.
original_headline: Mercado del cobre registra déficit de 30,000 toneladas métricas en septiembre: ICSG
